scenes.say: I gave three AIs my messy notes
and one rule: keep every fact. Add nothing.
A delayed launch, two bugs, a new date, the budget, and one extra test day. Seven facts. Simple, right?

scenes.label: ChatGPT
scenes.caption: thought about it… said nothing…
scenes.say: ChatGPT thought about it... said absolutely nothing... then changed its mind. Solid email, but it invented one tiny reason. Nine out of ten.

scenes.label: Claude
scenes.caption: kept 7 facts, said “all five” 🤦
scenes.say: Claude said untangling, kept every single fact, then proudly told me it kept all five. There were seven. Still, ten out of ten.

scenes.label: Gemini
scenes.caption: 11 seconds. Straight to Gmail.
scenes.say: Gemini didn't even think about it. Eleven seconds, straight into a Gmail draft, every fact. Ten.
Round one: Claude and Gemini tie, ChatGPT one point behind.
Four more rounds. Full showdown on Saturday.
